# Survival Hunter — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 16/0/35 — respec at levels 40 and 60. The decision loop walks 69 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. No party fixture places a member on this spec yet. [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/survival/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's per-spec table). No measured numbers for this spec: it has no row in the round-155 table, which lists the 14 specs with boss-fight data [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [survival.md](./survival.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **9 — pet attack** (`HS00d-pet-attack`) — level 10+ · intent `filler`
  - **When:** in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; the pet is not on the target; the target is hostile; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the target is attacking the resident or the lowest party health below 0%).
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target).
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/survival/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `core PetAI.cpp L465-L500`; `core Unit.cpp L9295-L9345`; `doc module/bots/src/Tick.cpp`; +1 more].
- **78 — Raptor Strike** (`HS12-raptor-strike`) — level 1+ · intent `filler` · spell 2973
  - **When:** the target is hostile; in melee range; Raptor Strike is off cooldown; at least 15 mana.
  - **Why:** 15 mana, 6 s categoryRecoveryTime, off the global cooldown, and Savage Strikes 2/2 in this build is about it.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/survival/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L2418`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; `DBC SpellRange.dbc:2`].
- **85 — Mongoose Bite** (`HS11-mongoose-bite`) — level 16+ · intent `filler` · spell 1495
  - **When:** the target is hostile; in melee range; Mongoose Bite is off cooldown; at least 30 mana.
  - **Why:** 30 mana, 5 s categoryRecoveryTime, melee.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/survival/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L1316`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; `DBC SpellRange.dbc:2`].
- **90 — Lacerate** (`HS09-lacerate`) — level 40+ · intent `filler` · spell 48049
  - **When:** the target is hostile; in melee range; the resident has the aura state 6 state; Lacerate is off cooldown.
  - **Why:** Turtle content: a Survival talent (408) at 30 that DependsOn Carve, free, 10 s recoveryTime, 8 s of bleed, and casterAuraState 6 -- AURA_STATE_CRIT, the state the core sets on a caster that has recently critically hit.
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/survival/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:408`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L25520`; `DBC SpellCastTimes.dbc:1`; +4 more].

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **HS00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 3); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **HS00u-tel-abim-surprise — Use Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise (item 60976, required level 55), the ranged AP food; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 57042 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HS00u-elixir-of-giants — Use Elixir of Giants:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Elixir of the Giants (item 9206, required level 38), strength for the melee Survival rotation (Elmgren's checklist); Juju Power is not in this file, so the stacking trap of L227 does not arise; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 11405 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HS00u-demonic-rune — Use Demonic Rune:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Demonic Rune (item 12662, level 0, vendor-sold, restores 900 mana for 600 health, 2 min category cooldown): "Demonic Runes for long fights" (survival.md L225); Survival is mana hungry (L169). Same gate as the shaman rule (SE00u-demonic-rune): under 20 per cent mana, health at 60 per cent or more.
- **HS00u-potion-of-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Potion of Quickness (item 61181, level 50, haste aura 45425, 2 min cooldown), in Sofie's Naxx kit (survival.md L224); on a boss with the buff down.
- **HS00b-call-pet — Call Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6082 'Taming the Beast', kit.yaml), costs nothing (spell_template manaCost 0) and needs no target: effectImplicitTargetA1 32, targets 0, so the loop's own targetGuid (healTarget or hostile) is irrelevant, the same way a self-only buff resolves regardless of what RotationAction passes (Loop.cpp's own comment, next to Fade and Inner Fire). Priority 7, straight after HS00a-eat (6) and before the opener (HS01 at 10) and every buff: THE PET WAS NEVER MISSING FROM THE DATABASE, ONLY FROM THE WORLD.
- **HS00c-revive-pet — Revive Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6081 'Training the Beast', kit.yaml, same acquisition tier as Call Pet), a 10 s cast (castingTimeIndex 7, SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 10000) and NOT free: manaCost 0 but manaCostPercentage 100, which Spell::CalculatePowerCost prices at 100 per cent of BASE mana for the caster's level (player_classlevelstats: hunter level 23 is 541) -- the whole bar, not a share of it. `mana_pct >= 100` was the first draft and was DISCARDED: it is only ever true at a single mana level, which is the same failure class this workstream's reactive rules already document elsewhere (a guard that is merely safe but rarely true just re-fires the refusal every tick), and decision 42 asks for a pet that WORKS, not one that is technically affordable and never revived.
- **HS00d-pet-attack — pet attack:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target). A defensive player pet ignores its owner's attack while it is out of combat (PetAI::OwnerAttacked returns when the pet is not in combat and its owner is a player), so with no rule that sends it in it fought only what hit it or its owner: on the tank's target on 84 of 169 in-combat ticks in round 79.
- **HS02-aspect-of-the-monkey — Aspect of the Monkey:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **HS03-aspect-of-the-wolf — Aspect of the Wolf:** The archive opens its Survival list with "Aspect of the Wolf (rank 7), pet on target first" and adds that "Hunter's Mark does not help melee (ranged-AP only)", and both halves are visible at the pin: Aspect of the Wolf (45650, trainer at 10) carries aura 99, SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, while Aspect of the Hawk (13165) carries aura 124, SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER, and every damage rule below this one except HS15-auto-shot and HS14-serpent-sting is a melee ability. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HS04-deterrence — Deterrence:** Below 40 the resident holds the Beast Mastery build (talents.yaml earlier_builds[0]), which does not take this Survival talent; it arrives with the respec at 40. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HS05-feign-death — Feign Death:** HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **HS05s-scare-beast-second — Scare Beast:** The guide, hunter/leveling.md L148: "On beasts, Scare Beast the second mob (1.5 s cast)"; the pet and the shots take the first. Alone only (in a party a feared mob runs into the group), the second attacker is a beast (`creature_type(1)`), 35 mana at level 14, 50 at rank 2 (level 30).
- **HS06-frost-trap — Frost Trap:** Their 0x10000 is SPELL_ATTR_NOT_SHAPESHIFT, which is a different bit and a different rule. Below 40 the hunter of this file fights with the Beast Mastery levelling build (talents.yaml earlier_builds, until 39) and has no Untamed Trapper, so the cast was a refused cast every tick.
- **HS07-explosive-trap — Explosive Trap:** Below 40 the hunter of this file fights with the Beast Mastery levelling build (talents.yaml earlier_builds, until 39) and has no Untamed Trapper, so the cast was a refused cast every tick.
- **HS08-immolation-trap — Immolation Trap:** Below 40 the hunter of this file fights with the Beast Mastery levelling build (talents.yaml earlier_builds, until 39) and has no Untamed Trapper, so the cast was a refused cast every tick.
- **HS11-mongoose-bite — Mongoose Bite:** At the pin it carries no casterAuraState, so unlike Lacerate it is available on cooldown rather than on a reaction.
- **HS09-lacerate — Lacerate:** Turtle content: a Survival talent (408) at 30 that DependsOn Carve, free, 10 s recoveryTime, 8 s of bleed, and casterAuraState 6 -- AURA_STATE_CRIT, the state the core sets on a caster that has recently critically hit. Below 40 the resident holds the Beast Mastery build (talents.yaml earlier_builds[0]), which does not take this Survival talent; it arrives with the respec at 40.
- **HS09b-mend-pet — Mend Pet:** Trainer spell at 12 (kit.yaml, trainer_learn_spell 1117), 50 mana at the pin (spell_template manaCost 50) and, contrary to how it reads, NOT instant: attributesEx 4 is SPELL_ATTR_EX_CHANNELED_1 and durationIndex 28 is 5000 ms -- 'heals your pet X health every second while you focus, lasts 5s' -- the same shape as the warlock's Health Funnel (755), which decision 44 keeps strictly out of combat. CHECKED BEFORE SHIPPING IT IN COMBAT: channelInterruptFlags is 31756 (0x7C0C) at the pin, which decodes to CHANNEL_FLAG_INTERRUPT (0x0004), CHANNEL_FLAG_MOVEMENT (0x0008) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DELAY (0x4000) -- CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE (0x0002) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE2 (0x0080) are both ABSENT, so taking a hit does not break this channel, which closes the specific re-fire risk (a half-broken channel next to an active fight) that would otherwise be the strongest argument against it.
- **HS10-carve — Carve:** Below 40 the resident holds the Beast Mastery build (talents.yaml earlier_builds[0]), which does not take this Survival talent; it arrives with the respec at 40.
- **HS14a-steady-shot-levelling — Steady Shot:** Below 40 this file carried Auto Shot and nothing else at range (its melee ladder needs the 40-and-up approach rule), while its talents are the Beast Mastery levelling build; these two shots give it the fillers the guide says to press.
- **HS14b-arcane-shot-levelling — Arcane Shot:** Below 40 this file carried Auto Shot and nothing else at range (its melee ladder needs the 40-and-up approach rule), while its talents are the Beast Mastery levelling build; these two shots give it the fillers the guide says to press.

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **HS00u-elixir-of-giants:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Elixir of the Giants (item 9206, required level 38), strength for the melee Survival rotation (Elmgren's checklist); Juju Power is not in this file, so the stacking trap of L227 does not arise; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 11405 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death.
- **HS02c-aspect-of-the-cheetah:** Same rule as HB02c-aspect-of-the-cheetah of HO-TKB-PLAY-280, which carries the reasoning (40 mana; `mana_pct >= 70` is our own floor, open question 3).
- **HS15-auto-shot:** The 2,923 autorepeat_active refusals (the push while it is already repeating) cannot be expressed here: no predicate says that Auto Shot is running, so that refusal is the runtime's (p3-runtime, p1-loop).
